name: Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source

galleryCharacter.key: Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source

imgDesc.text:
A heat source constructed using Prime Ice that generates an easy-to-use warming flame.
When within range of a heat source, you will no longer need to draw energy from the Eye of Graeae to keep warm.

galleryCharacter.key: Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source

imgDesc.text: The flame can follow you around within a certain area. However, do note that once you stray too far from the pedestal, the flame will return automatically to its base.

galleryCharacter.key: Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source

imgDesc.text: A heat source created out of Prime Ice. Though it is warm enough to melt snow and ice, it does not affect Prime Ice Constructs.
